paite: Huchibang in, nou zite aw, noumau pasalte thuthu in om un, huchi in alak ua khenkhat in Pathian thu zui kei mah le uh na tatdan uh zoh in a-om ding uhi.
heading: Pasalte Leh Zite Zuih Ding
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

paite: Laudan siam kawm a na tatdan siangthou uh en in.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

paite: Na kivatna uh polam kivatna samphek leh dangka-eng khi-oh hiam, puansilh a kivatte hilou in,
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

paite: lungtang a mihing thuguk lungsim thunuailut leh nunnem puansilh setheilou a kivat Pathian mitmuh in amanpha mahmah hi.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

paite: Huchibang in tuma lam a numei siangthou Pathian gingtate'n leng amau pasalte thuthu a om in akivan uhi.
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

paite: Sarah in Abraham, toupa chi a athuthu a a-om bang in; thil hoih hih a, khemlauna himhim lau lou a na om uleh Sarah tate na hi ding uhi.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

paite: Huchi mah bang in, nou pasalte aw, numei zaw bel kitambaihzaw ahih bang un leh hehpihna hinna tanpihte ahih bang un, theihsiamna toh pahtawidan siam kawm in theihna bang zel in na zite uh kem un, na thumna uh dal a a-omlouhna ding in.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

paite: Atawp pen in, na vek un lungsim mun khat in om unla, kilainattuah unla, thunuailut in om un.
heading: Khristian Lungsim Putdan
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

paite: Khelhna, khelhna in thuk kei unla, salhna, salhna a thuk sam lou in, vualzawl zaw un. Hiai vualzawlna tang ding a sap na hi uhi.
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

paite: "Hinna it a nihoihte muh ut in khelhna lak ah alei venghoih henla, amuk leng khemna thu gen lou ding in venghoih hen.
english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

paite: Gilou nungngatsan in thil hoih hih henla; kituahna zong in delh zel hen.
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

paite: Midiktatte tung ah Toupa mit atu a, abil in leng athumna lam uah adoh zel hi, himahleh Toupa mel in thil hihkhialte adou nak," chih gelh ahi.
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

paite: Thil hoih lam a phatuam na ngaih uleh na poikhoih ding uh kua a-om dia?
heading: Engbawlna A Khrist Etton Ding
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

paite: Himahleh diktatna ziak a na thuakta bang na hih uleh, na hampha ding uhi. Akihtakhuaina uh kihta kei un.
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

paite: Himahleh na lungtang uah Toupa in Khrist bawl un; noumau a om, na lametpen uh hon dong peuhmah dawng ding in mansa gige in thunuailuttak leh laudan siam kawm in om un;
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

paite: sia-le-pha theihna siangtak nei un, huchi in nou ahon gensiatna lam uah, Khrist a na omdan hoih uh gen thanghuaite hih zahlak in a-om ding uhi.
english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

paite: Thil gilou hih ziak a thuak sang in Pathian hoihsak lam ahihleh thil hoih hih ziak a thuak ahoihzaw hi.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

paite: Pathian kiang a hon pitheihna ding in Khrist in leng khelhnate a ding in khatvei athuakta hi, midiktat in midiktatloute sik in athuak a; sa ah sihsak in a-om a, Kha ah hinsak in a-omta hi.
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

paite: Huai kha in suangkul a kha omte kiang ah thu ava tangkoupih hi.
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

paite: Huai mite'n nidanglai a Noah dam lai a long bawl sung teng a, Pathian thuakzohna in angak lai in thu amang kei ua; huai long ah mi tawmchik, mi giat lel tui a pan humbit in a-om uhi.
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

paite: Huan huai tui in Jesu Khrist thohnawnna ziak a hotdamna baptisma lim hon ensak a, huai tuh pumpi nitna siansakna dan hilou in, sia-le-pha theihna siansakna ziak a Pathian kiang naihna ahi zaw hi.
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

paite: Amah van a pai in Pathian taklam ah a-om a; angelte, thuneihnate, thilhihtheihnate amah thuthu a omsak in a-omta hi.
english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.
